# High Select — source record

- **Origin:** the supplied experimental intake already in the Robot Lab experimental registry (archive `high-select-complete.zip`, CrispStrobe, BSD-3-Clause), reviewed natively and in the browser before promotion.
- **Adaptations:**
  - The licence line points at the packaged licence.
  - Rest stops (#1455): a Technic bush (3713) on each of the four input guide axles, under the lower toggle eye of each carriage, so the unpowered start pose rests on the bushes instead of back-driving both motors (cold sag 9.54° before, 0.27° after); 288 placements. Program unchanged.
  - The exchanged-input comparison `high-select-mirror` (same geometry, A and B itineraries exchanged) stays an experimental comparison entry.
- **Law:** at all 11 settled holds the passive bridge height equals max(a,b) of the two measured carriage pad heights within 0.033 mm (judge tolerance 0.1 mm), including both handovers, the 16 mm tie and the lower-input-only moves; the mirror program gives the same heights with the sides exchanged (within 0.027 mm).
- **Disconnection** (both bridge foot tiles and foot bricks removed): the inputs still run the full 16 mm itinerary, and the bridge leaves h = max(a,b) by 3.7 mm. The bridge then rests on the carriages through other parts, so it still follows the higher carriage with a shifted datum: the declared contact surfaces set the measured height.
